network_infrastructure_considerations.device_access: Server provides control over network devices - validate authorization
network_infrastructure_considerations.client_blocking: Client blocking requires confirmation workflows - verify safety checks
network_infrastructure_considerations.wlan_management: WLAN enable/disable requires confirmation - check implementation
network_infrastructure_considerations.camera_control: Protect camera reboots and privacy mode require authorization
network_infrastructure_considerations.door_unlock: Access door unlock is time-limited but irreversible - validate safeguards
network_infrastructure_considerations.led_flash: Device LED flash is safe operation - low security risk

security_notes.local_api_keys: UniFi controller API keys grant full network access - critical to monitor for exposure and rotate monthly
security_notes.site_manager_token: Cloud Site Manager token provides cross-site infrastructure access - requires secure storage and rotation
security_notes.legacy_credentials: Legacy API username/password for WLAN management - consider 2FA and app-specific passwords
security_notes.ssrf_protection: Built-in SSRF protection with allowed hosts whitelist - validate configuration and bypass prevention
security_notes.tls_verification: TLS verification can be disabled for local controllers - acceptable for home lab, must enable for production
security_notes.credential_storage: Verify secrets.env is properly gitignored and has restricted file permissions (600)
security_notes.multi_api_fallback: Server uses multiple authentication methods - ensure all APIs properly secured
security_notes.device_control: Server provides network device control - validate authorization and confirmation workflows
security_notes.camera_access: Protect API enables camera control and privacy mode - ensure proper access controls
security_notes.door_unlock: Access API enables door unlocking - time-limited but requires strong authorization
security_notes.key_rotation: Recommend monthly API key rotation for production environments

compliance_requirements.data_privacy: Network client data (MAC, IP, hostname) requires privacy considerations
compliance_requirements.physical_security: Door unlock capability requires physical security controls
compliance_requirements.video_surveillance: Camera privacy mode affects surveillance compliance
compliance_requirements.network_security: Client blocking affects network access controls
